bullets: Changed: In full screen, this bell sits next to the Clinic Template Tool name at the top left and stays there.
Changed: Your clinic workbook now opens on a Start Here page, with your clinic's appointment list for templates, access (3NA), cadence and recall. Patients show as LASFIR only.
Changed: Eligibility, benefits and billing tickets are worked centrally for now, so the Clinic Day tab isn't in new clinic files.

New: Clinic Day, the first tab of a new clinic file, lists every visit booked here with coverage, copay, deductible and OOP left, what the patient owes, card on file, OK to collect and copays. The tool keeps it up to date, so don't type on it.
New: Patients from other clinics who have a visit here are on the list too.
New: Each patient card has OK to collect (Yes or No, with your name and the time), Record a collection, and a short history.
Changed: Full screen opens in its own window, and asks before it closes. If your browser blocks the window, it opens inside Excel as before.
New: Look up a patient who isn't on the list, once the admin sets it up on your computer. Every lookup is logged with your name and reason, and nothing it shows is saved in the file.
New: A light/dark button at the top right, next to refresh and full screen. Your choice stays on this computer, and full screen follows it.

Changed: The Dev updates bell now sits next to the name at the top left of full screen, and isn't in the side pane. A red dot means something new. Click the bell to read it; nothing pops up on its own.
Changed: The refresh and full screen buttons are plain icons, like the other MHS add-ins.
Changed: The Dev Update bell floats again. Drag it anywhere; it starts at the bottom right.
New: When the tool opens, it asks for your name. Pick yours, or add it if you're new. Your name shows at the top; press it to switch user.
New: On a Clinic Eligibility file, the ticks and notes you save on Clinic Work carry the name you picked.
New: This bell, next to refresh and full screen, shows what changed in the tool. Hover over any of them to see what it does.
